mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome. I'm so glad you're here. Have you ever wondered what it truly means to leave something lasting behind? As we walk together through this journey, we'll shine a light on the heart of generosity, sacrifice, and the legacy we all hope to create. In Dying to Give, written by Gary B. Shelly, we're invited to explore those powerful moments at the edge of life—moments when giving takes on a whole new meaning. We'll meet people who offer parts of themselves, sometimes quite literally, and discover how these selfless acts ripple outwards—touching families, friends, and even strangers in ways they never expected. Along the way, we'll tackle the emotional and ethical questions that come with end-of-life decisions, and see how a single act of kindness can transform not just one life, but whole communities. Together, we'll uncover how compassion quietly weaves hope and connection into even the most difficult goodbyes, and how the courage to give can inspire healing, renewal, and a deeper sense of what it means to be human. So, are you ready to discover how giving shapes not just the world we leave, but also the people we become? Let's begin this meaningful exploration—together.
